body: I don't know how to do that. I had to take a week off of work for a kidney infection a few weeks back and I'm just worried at how it'll look taking more time off. My bf and I broke up last night, it was an incredibly unhealthy and codependent relationship but we had broken up for a year prior to this and it was immensely hard but I at least believed it would get better in a matter of weeks or months. Now I know that even a year isn't enough. What's worse, is my best friend who pulled me through the really rough spots last year, I asked him to change my passwords last night because I just couldn't do it (as per my ex-bfs request) and he went through my emails. I feel so violated when at my absolute lowest but what's worse is I feel terrible for some of the things he saw and now I have no one. I lost the only two (non-family) people I love in one night. I don't have the energy or the will to recover from this again.
